prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.hint: Auto uses the OS language. Unsupported languages fall back to English (RN-120).
help.getting_started.title: Getting started
help.getting_started.body:
1) Configure → Sites / Equipment / Programs
2) Select Site and Program in the ContextBar
3) Observatory → Program: link targets and follow PO-* steps
4) Observe or Import, then Analyze
5) Contribute to export to networks

Press F1 anytime to open this help.
help.night.title: Night
help.night.body: Meteo / radar and daily plans for the selected site and night date. Plans come from active observational programs.
help.observatory.title: Observatory
help.observatory.body: Session capture, unified Import (FITS / Radio / Specialties), Observe channels, and Timing (occultations). The Program tab guides the active campaign.
help.program.title: Active program
help.program.body: Shows the ContextBar program: linked targets, PO-* workflow steps (navigate with Go), and a shortcut to Contribute for the template networks.
help.analyze.title: Analyze
help.analyze.body: Photometry, spectrum extraction, blink / plate-solve, FITS viewer, and curves from measurement_points. Products inherit the ContextBar program_id.
help.contribute.title: Contribute
help.contribute.body: Export / submit packs for AAVSO, MPC, TNS, BeSS, ExoClock, IOTA. Pick a product UUID from Archive. Credentials live in credentials.json.
help.archive.title: Archive
help.archive.body: Browse observations and analysis products. Select a product for detail and plot. Copy UUID for Contribute.
help.configure.title: Configure
help.configure.body: Sites, equipment, programs (from PO-* templates), targets, Preferences (language), and Help.
help.language.title: Language
help.language.body: Supported UI languages: Portuguese, Spanish, English. Preference Auto detects the OS language; otherwise pick pt / es / en. Unknown languages use English (RN-120).
help.ask_hint: Answers only with corpus citations (AC-196). No LLM in this mode.
help.ask_no_archive: SQLite archive unavailable for KB search.
